stories.title: Define comparison request/response schema
stories.description: Create Pydantic models for comparative evaluation including input (list of provider IDs/NPIs) and output (ranked providers, scores, measure breakdown, strengths/weaknesses). Ensure compatibility with existing evaluation outputs.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models/provider_search_models.py (pattern for Pydantic models); GAP: No comparison schema exists.

stories.title: Implement provider comparison engine
stories.description: Build core service to aggregate provider scores, normalize across providers, rank results, and compute relative strengths and weaknesses using existing scoring and explanation services.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/provider_detail_service.py (domain service pattern); GAP: No comparison logic exists in domain layer.

stories.title: Expose comparison via Evaluate Care facade and API
stories.description: Add comparison orchestration to evaluate_care_facade and register tool endpoint for LLM/tool_router usage, returning structured comparison output.

stories.title: Add unit and integration tests for comparison
stories.description: Create tests validating ranking correctness, schema validation, edge cases (missing scores, ties), and API/tool integration behavior.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py (testing pattern); GAP: No tests exist for comparison capability.
